errorView.heading: Something went wrong
errorView.body: Please try again. If this keeps happening, contact support with the reference below.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

problem.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields need attention. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
problem.NOT_FOUND: This couldn't be found. It may have been moved, removed, or isn't available to you.
problem.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action isn't available right now. Please refresh and try again.
problem.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
problem.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email or password doesn't match our records. Please try again.
problem.MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID: This sign-in attempt has expired. Please sign in again.
problem.MFA_CODE_INVALID: That code didn't match. Check the app or recovery code and try again.
problem.PASSWORD_INCORRECT: That password doesn't match your current one. Please try again.
problem.TOKEN_INVALID: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
problem.CSRF_FAILED: This session needs to refresh. Please try again.
problem.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your email address to continue.
problem.MFA_ALREADY_ENABLED: Two-factor authentication is already on for this account.
problem.MFA_NOT_ENABLED: Two-factor authentication isn't on for this account.
problem.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
problem.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than the allowed size. Use a smaller file or split it.
problem.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: This workspace has run out of storage. Delete some files or ask the workspace owner to add more space.
problem.PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_UNDELETABLE: Your personal workspace can't be deleted. Only workspaces you created can be removed.
problem.PRECONDITION_FAILED: This changed somewhere else since it was loaded. Reload it, then make your changes again.
problem.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: This couldn't be saved. Please reload the page and try again.
problem.DRAFT_INVALID: This plan has issues that need to be fixed before it can run. Review the highlighted steps.
problem.PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH: This plan changed since it was shown. Please review it again before approving.
problem.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This run can't do that right now. Its current status doesn't allow this action.
problem.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH: This request couldn't be repeated as sent. Please refresh and try again.
problem.BASE_VERSION_STALE: A newer version of this workflow exists. Reload it, then map again from the latest version.
problem.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. If this keeps happening, contact support with the reference below.

validation.JSON_INVALID: This request couldn't be read. Please try again.
validation.MODEL_ATTRIBUTES_TYPE: This request couldn't be read. Please try again.
validation.STRING_PATTERN_MISMATCH: This doesn't match the expected format.
validation.LITERAL_ERROR: Choose one of the allowed options.
validation.MFA_CODE_OR_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Enter a code or a recovery code, not both.
validation.INT_FROM_FLOAT: Enter a whole number, not a fraction.
validation.TOO_LONG: Keep this to {max_length} items or fewer.
